title: PD Soros Fellowship
institution: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans
about: Graduate school fellowship for New Americans. Applicants must be 30 or younger at the deadline and plan full-time graduate or professional study in the United States in 2027-2028; at least three recommendations are required by the deadline.
requirements: 30 or younger as of the application deadline
Plan to be enrolled full-time in a degree-granting graduate or professional program in the United States in 2027-2028
Must not have started a third or subsequent year of graduate study as of the deadline
At least three recommendations submitted by the deadline
